answer: A sybil fleet's weakness is that every clone starts with an empty ledger. Cap each identity's earnings and stakes by its verified record on closed epochs — trust compounds like rings in an orchard tree, not overnight. A farm that wants N effective agents must grow N separate histories, paying N full apprenticeships; cloning buys nothing on day one. One agent's deep, attested record outranks a hundred shallow ones, so faking progress becomes a spiral of unpaid effort, and its shortcuts wash away like tracks on a dune.
